implementation_notes: A top-level `const val` in an object or file, or an `object Policy` for behaviour. Extension functions on a shared type are the idiomatic home for a rule that applies to that type. `value class` wraps repeated primitive-with-validation pairs.
idiom_name: object Policy / top-level const + value class
pitfalls: Duplicated when-branches that should be one polymorphic hierarchy
Constants declared inside a composable or class instead of a shared object
